entries.17d630f56edaf591: Its predecessor, Mizuho Kikaku Kogyo Co., Ltd., was established in 1971, and in 1998 the current business was launched as Digital Adventure Co., Ltd. Its head office is in Roppongi, Minato-ku, Tokyo, and consolidated employees as of December 31, 2025 numbered 104. Its parent companies include SM ENTERTAINMENT Co., Ltd. of South Korea and others, and it has one consolidated subsidiary, Everything Japan Co., Ltd.
entries.20f206b6bc47ad8c: The segment information records revenue from external customers of ¥7,816 million from the Entertainment Business and ¥2,378 million from the Rights & Media Business for the fiscal year ended December 2025, and the sales performance records the three main counterparties and their percentages.

entries.2d8d3741167554a0: It is responsible for the exclusive management of SME artists in Japan, and plans and operates concerts and events, sells merchandise, and conducts music activities. In addition, it provides pay-TV broadcasting through its own television station KNTV, acquires and sells rights to Korean dramas and other content, and provides online streaming.

entries.5dcc796386ac2c27: Its main customers are concert audiences, artists’ fans and KNTV viewers.
entries.638cd0df1b1c1898: As a media content company centered on the Hallyu business, it has adopted as its management philosophy the goal of making people’s lives more enjoyable and richer and contributing to society.
entries.66153a40e9276dfb: A business that provides pay broadcasting services via CS broadcasting, CATV and IPTV through its own TV channel, KNTV. In addition to broadcasting Korean content such as news, K-POP and variety shows, centered on Korean dramas, it acquires rights such as broadcasting rights, distribution rights and merchandising rights for dramas and variety shows and turns them into business, and also provides online distribution. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥2,378 million.
entries.800d67ed0093dd98: Its strategy focuses on expanding from operations that rely on the parent group’s artist IP to developing original IP originating in Japan.
entries.85e3dae2bc6d9018: The entertainment business related to SME artists accounts for about 8 tenths of revenue, with the remainder coming from the rights and broadcasting business for Korean content. Sales to 3 major customers exceed 5 tenths of the total, showing a concentration in counterparties.
entries.8ab283217157ddf2: Its management policy states a shift to a proactive management structure for sustainable growth that does not depend on the trends of specific artists, and the focused allocation of management resources to strengthening domestic marketing and discovering and developing its own original IP.
entries.8ff4334f3d68a566: It is responsible for the exclusive management of SME artists in Japan and, based on its broad artist lineup, states that it forms a highly loyal fan community by providing an integrated offering from concerts to CDs/DVDs and merchandise sales. It is also promoting in-house production from master recording through to distribution.

entries.b0be14e0feaa82de: A business model that exclusively manages the Japan activities of SME artists, earning revenue from concerts and merchandise sales, as well as from rights to Korean content and the operation of its own broadcasting station.
entries.b33411c12c695006: In the fiscal year ended December 2025, it held a total of 185 concerts, drawing about 1.43 million attendees, and its operational capacity to continue staging large-scale performances forms the foundation of its business.
entries.b73cb769aacc43f3: Net income attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥375 million.
entries.cca77052ad907dea: As a media content company centered on the Hallyu business, it has adopted as its management philosophy the goal of making people’s lives more enjoyable and richer and contributing to society. Over the medium to long term, it aims to shift to a “proactive management structure” in which the Japan base leads market analysis, creates unique value and transmits it worldwide, and it will focus management resources on discovering and developing its own original IP. It also aims to establish a revenue cycle that extends from the music business to adjacent areas such as merchandise sales, the travel business and the Rights & Media Business.
entries.ce2405e686725d18: The business handles exclusive management in Japan of artists belonging to the SM Entertainment group in Korea (SME artists), and plans and runs concerts at domes and arenas, music activities, merchandise sales and appearances in various media. It also supports the Japanese activities of Korean artists belonging to other companies. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥7,816 million. The head office (Minato-ku, Tokyo) is disclosed as a business facility used for sales, production and operations of this business.
